name: Forest Workshop
description: A portrait cozy workshop game in development. This 0.4 build adds automatic production (a gathering yard and a processing bench running on your rules, stock protection, upgrades, selling, a work report and the 72-hour absence cap) on top of residents registered from your characters and personas (with an optional language-model rebuild suggestion), your own uploaded resident pictures stored as WebP, pairs between any two residents, and backups that carry the pictures; production, invitations and stories follow. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → 숲결 공방.
